mapper.select: select i.*, u_patient.username as patientName, u_uploader.username as uploadedName from image i join user u_patient on i.patient_id = u_patient.id join user u_uploader on i.uploaded_by = u_uploader.id where u_patient.username like concat('%', #{PatientName}, '%')

select i.*, u_patient.username as patientName, u_uploader.username as uploadedName from image i join user u_patient on i.patient_id = u_patient.id join user u_uploader on i.uploaded_by = u_uploader.id where u_uploader.username like concat('%', #{UploadedName}, '%')

select i.*, u_patient.username as patientName, u_uploader.username as uploadedName from image i join user u_patient on i.patient_id = u_patient.id join user u_uploader on i.uploaded_by = u_uploader.id where u_patient.id_card like concat('%', #{IdCard}, '%')

select i.*, u_patient.username as patientName, u_uploader.username as uploadedName from image i join user u_patient on i.patient_id = u_patient.id join user u_uploader on i.uploaded_by = u_uploader.id where i.patient_id = #{patientId}

select i.*, u_patient.username as patientName, u_uploader.username as uploadedName from image i join user u_patient on i.patient_id = u_patient.id join user u_uploader on i.uploaded_by = u_uploader.id
and u_patient.username like concat('%', #{patientName}, '%')
and u_patient.id_card like concat('%', #{patientIdCard}, '%')
and i.modality like concat('%', #{modality}, '%')
and i.tags like concat('%', #{tags}, '%')
and i.uploaded_at >= #{startDate}
and i.uploaded_at <= #{endDate}
